title: Button - Outline On Dark
description: Transparent outline pill button for secondary CTAs inside permanently-dark sections, pairing with Button - Primary On Dark. Not a reuse of Button - Secondary Outline: that style's border/text tokens (`button.outline.*`) flip with the light/dark style variation toggle, which would go illegible against a section that's dark in both variations — this uses the constant `text.on-dark` token instead, same on-dark family as the rest of the dark-section content. Hover contract in src/scss/animations/_button-motion.scss.
